notes: Red Bull replaces the original Kia banner cleanly. The dark band tone and brightness of the composite are an excellent match for the original signage band — at first glance the Red Bull wordmark reads as genuinely painted onto the same backdrop as the original ad. Edges are clean across early/mid/late motion strips with no visible seam. The wordmark stays locked to the banner panel through camera motion. Texture is close but the Red Bull mark looks a hair sharper / cleaner than the slightly noisier original, which is the only thing keeping texture_match shy of a 5. Geometry and scale are spot-on relative to the surrounding seat block.
